tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje sogs la smre bshags kyis gsol ba gdab pa thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i gdung dbyangs bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ra we/ byin rlabs thugs rje'i bdag nyid dngos brgyud kyi// bla ma rnams dang skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i tshogs// dam tshig bya ra legs nyes stangs 'dzin pa'i// mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams dang khyad par du// thugs rje chen po dam tshig rdo rje dpal// dri med margad mdog can gzugs bzang ba// rnam dag 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil nas mdzes// ji ltar mkha' la nyi 'od stong 'bar bzhin// dpa' bo 'od zer stong 'bar lham me ba// srid pa gsum gyi sa mkhan ston par grags// khams gsum 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// byams mgon thugs rje'i lha khyod bdag la dgongs// bdag ni thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas// lam log lam stor srid pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams// sngon tshe las log sdig pa spyad pas nongs// sdig pa'i las rnams ci byas rab gnong 'gyod// dar zhing drag pa'i las de dbang btsan pas// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byings gyur te// zhe sdang 'bar ba'i me yis rang rgyud bsregs// gti mug mun pa'i tshogs kyis shes rgyud rmongs// 'dod chags rgya mtsho'i nang du rnam shes byings// nga rgyal chen po'i ri bos ngan 'gror mnan// phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshubs mas 'khor bar g.yengs// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i mdud pa dam pos bcings// 'dod pa me mdag dong 'dra'i 'obs su lhungs// sdug bsngal drag po'i 'dam rdzab char ltar babs// me khams nyi ma'i dugs ni steng nas tsha// chu khams sa yi rlan ni 'og nas grang*// phyi yi ser bu'i ngad ni thad nas tsha// kun nas 'khrugs pa'i rlung ni khong nas ldang*// de lta'i sdug bsngal shin tu bzod dka' yang*// sdom pa'i yi dam gzhig tu ga la rung*// sdug bsngal kun dang bsdos nas sdom bsrungs shing*// mos pa'i dad pas 'phags mchog mi 'dor na// 'phags mchog 'gro don mi mdzad ci zhig dgongs// byams mgon ci slad bdag la thugs mi brtse// bdag 'dra'i blun rmongs las ngan sdig po che// las kyi dbang gis snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skyes// skyes pas 'gyod do las la yi re chad// yi chad 'gyod kyang las dbang bcos su med// las kyi shugs ni chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra// las dbang chu rgyun 'gog par shin tu dka'// bka' la zhugs kyang bka' bzhin rngo ma thogs// lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa'i dbang du song*// sdig pa'i las dbang drag po'i me 'bar bas// rnam shes dbang po'i myu gu gdungs gyur te// phung po sgyu ma'i lus 'dis mi bzod na// byams mgon thugs rje can gyis dgongs lags sam// sdig pa'i khur chen mi dge bcu dang ni// mtshams med nye ba'i mtshams med la sogs pa// bgyis dang bgyid stsal dga' ba bsgoms pa ste// rang bzhin kha na ma tho ci mchis dang*// so thar byang sems rgyud sde 'og ma yi// bslab dang dam tshig nyams sogs bcas 'gal kun// ye shes spyan ldan khyed kyi spyan snga ru// mthol zhing bshags so nam yang mi 'chab bo// khyad par bla med theg pa'i sgor zhugs te// rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig sogs// sta gon 'jug pa'i gnas skabs khas blangs shing*// dam bzhag tshul las 'das pa mthol lo bshags// dbang rgyud man ngag ster ba'i slob dpon la// snying nas smod sogs rtsa ltung bcu bzhi po// mi shes pa dang ma gus bag med pa// kun dkris drag pos spyad pa mthol lo bshags// dam tshig med pa'i rigs mar dga' ba sogs// yan lag ltung ba brgyad po spyad pa dang*// dang po'i las pas bsgrub bya bcu bdun sogs// bsten bya'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// ji bzhin sgra min dam tshig bzhi dang ni// dgongs te gsungs bzhi brtul zhugs nyer lnga sogs// tha dad rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dam tshig la// thos pa chung bas 'gal ba mthol lo bshags// mnyam gzhag rjes spyod bza' dang srung ba dang*// mi 'bral 'chang ba lnga tshan bzhis bsdus pa'i// dbang bzhi'i dam tshig la sogs man ngag la// klong du ma gyur 'gal ba mthol=

/gsar bu brtan pa thob dang ches brtan pa'i// sa mtshams ma phyed sbyor sgrol la sogs pa'i// brtul zhugs log par spyad pas bstan pa dkrug /rang gzhan phung khrol bskyed pa= /phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa ma bskyangs shing*// nang du 'gro phan lhag bsam zhan pa dang*// gsang bar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma bsgrubs pas// sdom gsum ming rkyang shor ba= /sbyang rtog sbar gsum ma nus dam rdzas bsten// bsnyen sgrub tshad du ma 'khyol las la sbyar// rtsa rlung nus pa ma thon 'dod pa spyad// rgyu med 'bras bu btsal ba= /bde 'dod nyon mongs dbang gis sdug bsngal bsgrubs// mkhas 'dod le lo'i dbang gis chos ma bsgrubs// grol 'dod snang shes dbang gis 'khor bar bcings// 'bras 'dod rgyud dang bral ba= /dad mos brtse gdung blo gtod zhan pa yis// bla ma mchog dang mched lcam thugs ma zin// bsnyen sgrub g.yel zhing mchod gtor chags sogs kyis// mkha' 'gro dam can khrel ba mthol lo bshags// mdor na tshe 'dir zhe dang sdig grogs kyis// bslus pas tshor dang ma tshor sdig pa ni// mtho ris thar pa 'grub pa'i gegs gyur cing*// ngan song 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur ci mchis pa// rab tu gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags lags na// dmigs med mkhyen dang brtse ba'i ke ta kas// bdag rgyud nyes ltung rnyogs ma bgrungs nas kyang*// dag gtsang tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol// nyi zla ltar gsal padma ltar bzhad pa'i// 'phags pa'i zhal bzang lta bar 'tshal lags kyang*// thogs ma med nas ma rig ling thog gis// ldongs pa'i chu bur mig gis ma mthong na// 'gro ba'i mgon khyod da lta gang na bzhugs// sdug bsngal drag po shin tu mi bzod pa// shin tu skrag cing skyi g.ya' rab 'jigs nas// dung dung gdungs pa'i smre sngags 'di 'don cing*// nyam thag phongs pa'i nga ros 'o dod 'bod// byams mgon thugs rje can gyis gsan lags sam// nam zhig 'chi 'pho lus sems brje ba'i tshe// gnyen bshes grogs dang bral te gshin rjes khrid// de tshe 'jig rten nye dus mi bstongs te// las kyi dbang gis bdag rang gcig pur khrid// dus der bdag la mgon skyabs ma mchis na// byams mgon khyod kyis 'khor bar bdag gtong ngam// las kyis mnar ba'i skye bo bdag 'dra ba// thog ma med pa'i dus nas lam log pas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas las ma thar te// bskal pa dpag med skye ba ji snyed du// sngon chad lus blangs grangs med zhig gyur te// sha rus bsags na 'jig rten gtos dang mnyam// rnag khrag bsags na rgya mtsho chen po tsam// las 'phro bsags na bsam 'das brjod mi lang*// khams gsum bgrang zhing skye ba mang brgyud kyang*// byas pa'i las rnams don med chud re zos// skye ba grangs med ji snyed de tsam la// skye ba gcig cig kho na tsam gyis las// bla med byang chub don du rab 'bad na// de tsam byas pa'i las la'ang don re yod// las ni dbang btsan nyon mongs stobs che bas// sha khrag 'dus pa'i lus blangs 'khor bar 'khyams// sdug bsngal drag pos srid pa'i btson rwar tshud// mi bzod sdug bsngal drag po 'di myong na// nyes byas thams cad rang gi las las byung*// byams mgon thugs rje can gyis bzod lags sam// thugs rje chen pos ngan song rgyun bcad de// nyon mongs las kyi rlung ni bzlog tu gsol// nyon mongs las kyi rlung ni dbang btsan nas// ma rig mun pa'i gling du gtan 'khyams na// ye shes sgron me'i zer gyis mi gzigs sam// nyes byas las kyi 'bras bu mi bzod na// thugs rje can khyod phrin las mi mdzad dam// dug gsum bzod dka'i nad kyis gdungs lags na// thugs rje thabs mkhas sman gyis mi gso 'am// phyin ci log gi g.yang sar lhung lags na// thugs rje myur mgyogs phyag gis mi 'dzin nam// sdug bsngal drag po'i las dbang me 'bar na// thugs rje'i bsil bu chu rgyun mi 'bebs sam// sdug bsngal chen pos mnar ro ra mda' mdzod// re sas slu bar ma mdzad mthu stobs can// gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad par// zhal bzhes mang po'i dam bca' ma mdzad dam// mthong thos dran reg 'byung bar ma gsungs sam// snyigs ma'i dus kyi ngan spyod ma gzigs sam// ngan song rgyu 'bras sgrub par ma gzigs sam// sdug bsngal 'ba' klong 'khrugs pa ma mkhyen nam// nus mthu dpag med mnga' ba ma lags sam// byams mgon 'gro don mdzad par 'phyis pa tsam// khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas su sbyangs sbyangs nas// nam zhig rang gis 'bras bu thob pa'i tshe// 'phags pa thugs rjes ci 'tshal don ma mchis// sems can las 'phro rang sor bzhag na ni// 'phags pa'i thugs rjes su la ci zhig bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol bar zhal bzhes pa'i// dam bcas don de de ring dgongs su gsol// 'phags mchog khyed la thugs rje'i stobs mnga' na// yal yol le lo btang snyoms ma mdzad par// snying nas gzigs shing thugs rje rgyal ba'i lha// re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes zungs// zhes pa 'di ni slob dpon zla ba grags pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la smre sngags kyis gsol ba cung zad kha spos te bshags pa'i tshig dang spel ba'o// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba'i dbang du byas na/

byin rlabs thugs rje'i sogs thog ma'i shlo ka 'dra ba la/ thugs rje chen po bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems// dri med dung mdog mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// rnam dag 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil ltar mdzes// ji ltar mkha' la nyi 'od stong 'bar bzhin// zhes pa man chad gong dang 'dra zhing tshig ris 'di lta bu ni snga 'gyur sgyu 'phrul bshags pa'i rgyud las kyang byung ngo*// 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i maṇḍal dang*/ so so'i sbyin sreg kho bos byas pa'i dkyus su 'jug rgyu yin la/ gal te za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sreg blugs la sbyar bar mos na/ thugs rje chen po bcom ldan he ru ka /dri med dbang sngon lhun po'i sku mchog la// ye shes me yis 'khyud pa'i gzi byin ni// zhes tshig rkang gsum brje ba tsam ni khyad par ro// gsum po gang la'ang tshang ma gdon par ma lcogs na/ dag gtsang tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ zhes pa yan chad kyis 'thus pa yod do// 'di ni sdig ltung khur chen gyis non kyang dge sbyong ltar 'chos pa wā gind+ra su siddhi rang nyid kyi kha ton du bris pa 'dis gzhan la'ang phan thogs par gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
